title: Official
description: A person and every office they have held, past or present. One YAML file per person (openstates/people convention). People change roles — a Representative can become a Senator, a district can be renumbered by redistricting — but the shape of a role itself rarely changes, so each office held is one entry in 'roles'. Contact fields are copied verbatim from the official municipal source (CivicPatch convention).

name.description: Verbatim as published on the official municipal source.

roles.description: One entry per office held. Not required to be in chronological order; use each entry's term.start/end to determine sequence. A person with one office has a one-item array.

jurisdiction_id.description: Must resolve to a jurisdiction file in this repo.

office_id.description: Must resolve to an office embedded in the referenced jurisdiction.

how_seated.description: How the person came to hold the seat. 'elected' records are expected to cross-validate against an election linkage.

image.description: URL of a photo of this person, as published by the official source (CivicPatch's Official schema has this same field).

contact.description: Quick-reference contact info. For people with more than one physical office (a DC/capitol office plus one or more district offices), 'phone' here is the primary/capitol number for convenience — the full set of offices lives in 'addresses'.

addresses.description: This person's physical contact offices — e.g. one DC/capitol office plus any number of local district offices (a member of Congress commonly has several). Distinct from a role's 'office_id', which identifies the elected position itself, not a place to reach them at.

classification.description: 'capitol' = DC or state-capitol office; 'district' = local constituent office. At most one 'capitol' entry is expected; any number of 'district' entries.

name.description: Label distinguishing multiple offices of the same classification, e.g. 'Hyannis District Office' vs. 'New Bedford District Office'.
